<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/version"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the running instance's version in localVersion. When the update check succeeds, remoteVersion is the newest GitHub release on the instance's update channel and version is its legacy alias, not the instance's version. Remote fields are omitted when the check is disabled, fails, or returns an unparseable release tag.
